desc.en-us:
While countless 'better' ways of cooking Food have been invented in the last few hundred years, few are as durable or easy to fabricate as the OK-Zoomer microwave. Licensed from Xigo, the plans are based on a classic model from the mid-21st century, giving it a charmingly retro feel. But don't worry, it oscillates Water molecules more than adequately.
Just bolt it to a Powered Bench using a Wrench to power it, follow the recipe, and you're cooking.
desc.zh-hans: 尽管在过去几百年里发明了无数'更好'的烹饪 食物 方法, 但很少有像OK-Zoomer微波炉这样耐用或易于制造的. 该设计授权自 Xigo , 基于21世纪中期的经典型号, 赋予其迷人的复古感. 不过别担心, 它能充分振荡 水 分子. 只需用 扳手 将其固定在 供电长桌 上并供电, 按照食谱操作, 即可开始烹饪

desc.en-us:
The Xigo Cannifier requires Empty Can and cooked food to create long-lasting, easily stored sustenance. Note that the Cannifier must be bolted to a Powered Bench for power, and only accepts cooked food and tin cans.

OPERATION

1. Add the correct ingredients to the device via the hopper in the TOP.

2. Close the device using the dropdown handle.

3. Activate the device.

4. Remove canned goods from the outlet in the FRONT.

Note: the Cannifier will flash an error on its activation switch if you attempt to activate it before closing it.
desc.zh-hans:
Xigo 罐头封装机需 空罐 与烹制好的 食物 来制作 长效 耐储存食品. 注意: 必须固定在 供电长桌 上获取电力, 且仅接受熟食与锡罐.
操作指南

通过顶部进料口放入原料
下拉手柄关闭设备
激活设备
从前端出口取出成品
注意: 若未关闭设备直接激活, 开关将闪烁报错

desc.en-us:
The Genetic Analyzer can be used to process samples from the Plant Sampler. Once processed, the genetic information of the sampled plant can be viewed by clicking on the search button.

Individual Gene Value Widgets:
Most gene values will appear as a sliding bar between a minimum value on the left and a maximum value on the right. The actual value of the gene is in the middle of the bar, in orange.

Multiple Gene Value Widgets:
For temperature and pressure ranges, four genes appear on the same widget. The orange values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for growth. Outside of this range, the plant will stop growing and eventually die. The blue values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for ideal growth. Inside of this range, the plant will grow at maximum speed. The white values above the bar are the minimum and maximum achievable values for the growth threshold.
desc.zh-hans:
处理完 植物基因取样器 样本后, 点击搜索按钮可查看植物基因信息.

单基因值组件:
多数基因以滑动条显示最小值（左）与最大值（右）, 实际值以橙色居中显示.

多基因值组件:
温压范围基因四合一显示, 橙色值为生长阈值范围, 超出则停止生长直至死亡；蓝色值为理想生长范围, 实际生长条件位于蓝色区域内部时生长速度最快；白色值为可调控阈值极限

desc.en-us:
The Genetic Splicer can be used to copy a single gene from one 'source' plant to another 'target' plant of the same type. After copying, the source plant will be destroyed.

To begin splicing, place a plant or seed bag in the left slot (source) and place another plant or seed bag of the same type in the right slot (target). You can select a gene using the arrow buttons. Close the sliding door and press the green activate button. Once splicing has begun, the device will be locked until the process has finished (which will take approximately twenty minutes). If you want to cancel splicing you can power off the bench or detach the appliance as a last resort.
desc.zh-hans:
将同类型'源'植物单个 基因 复制到'目标'植物, 此过程中源植物会被销毁.

操作步骤:
左侧槽位放置源植物/种子袋, 右侧槽放置同类目标植物/种子袋, 箭头按钮选择想复制的基因. 选择完成后, 关闭滑门点击绿色激活按钮. 此过程需要约20分钟完成, 期间设备会被锁定. 如果想强制终止, 可以断电或拆卸设备

desc.en-us:
The Genetic Stabilizer can be used to manipulate gene stability on a specific Plants or Seeds. It has two modes Stabilize and Destabilize.
Stabilize: Increases all genes stability by 50%.
Destabilize: Decreases all gene stability by 10% other than a chosen gene which will received decreased stability by 50%.
desc.zh-hans:
具备稳定与解稳两种模式:
稳定: 所有基因稳定性+50%
解稳: 指定基因稳定性-50%, 其余基因-10%

desc.en-us: Sitting somewhere between a high powered juicer and an alchemist's alembic, the Xigo reagent processor turns certain raw materials and food items into cooking and crafting ingredients. Indispensible in any space kitchen, just bolt it to the bench, and you're ready to go.
desc.zh-hans: 原料加工机介于强力榨汁机和炼金术士的蒸馏器之间,  Xigo 原料加工机将某些原材料和食物转化为烹饪和制作原料. 任何太空厨房都不可或缺, 只需将其固定在工作台上即可使用

desc.en-us: The seed tray can hold up to twelve plants or seeds and can be used to facilitate fast experimentation and testing of plant genetics.
desc.zh-hans: 最多容纳12株植物/种子, 用于快速基因实验测试

desc.en-us: A more heavily reinforced version of the iconic Dynamic Crate, the Crate Mk II is resistant to incredibly high pressures and temperatures. Short of disposing of it in a black hole, the Mk II is about as safe as luggage gets.
desc.zh-hans: 标志性 储物箱 的强化版本, MkII储物箱可承受极高压力与温度. 除非投入黑洞, MkII堪称最安全的储物装置

desc.en-us:
The low frequency oscillator (or LFO) makes everything sound dark, twisted and crunchy by altering the shape of the waves output by a Logic Step Sequencer.

To set up an LFO:

1. Place the LFO unit
2. Set the LFO output to a Passive Speaker
2. Set a sequencers' output to LFO - so the sequencer's signal runs through the LFO to a speaker.
3. Place a Stop Watch or use an existing one, then use a Logic Writer to write it to the LFO.
4. Use another logic writer to write the BPM to the LFO.
5. You are ready. This is the future. You're in space. Make it sound cool.

For more info, check out the music page.
desc.zh-hans:
低频振荡器（LFO）通过改变 逻辑步进音序器 输出的波形形态, 使声音呈现阴暗、扭曲和粗粝质感.

设置LFO步骤:

放置LFO单元
将LFO输出设为 扬声器
将音序器输出设为LFO, 使信号经LFO传输至扬声器
放置 码表 或使用现有计时器, 用 逻辑写入 将其写入LFO
用另一逻辑写入器将BPM写入LFO
准备就绪. 这是未来. 你在太空. 让它听起来酷炫.
更多信息请查阅 音乐页面

desc.en-us: The Sinotai-designed Huxi portable air conditioner cools by drawing heat from the atmosphere and storing it, or adding heat to the atmosphere from its internal tank. With a max internal pressure of 8106kPa, its capacity is relatively limited, physics being clear on this subject. To extend its temperature storage ability, bolt the Huxi to a Tank Connector, then connect it to a pipe network supplying hot or cold gases.
desc.zh-hans: Sinotai 设计的Huxi便携式空调通过吸收大气热量储存, 或从内部储罐向大气释放热量来实现制冷/制热. 其最大内部压力为8106kPa, 容量相对有限——物理定律对此有明确限制. 要扩展其温度储存能力, 请将Huxi用螺栓固定在 储罐连接器 上, 再接入可供应制冷或制热 气体 的管道网络

desc.en-us: When dead players decay they will move into a body bag. If they have not respawned the dead player can be revived in a CryoTube.
desc.zh-hans: 当玩家死亡并开始腐烂后, 尸体会被移动到尸体袋中. 如果他们并未重生, 可以在 冷冻舱 中复活他们.

desc.en-us: The humble dynamic crate has become a symbol of Stationeer invention and independence. With twelve slots and handles at either end for ease of carriage, it's both standard issue and critical kit for cadets and Commanders alike.
desc.zh-hans: 这款基础储物箱已成为 Stationeer 创新精神的象征. 12格容量搭配便携提手, 是学员与指挥官的标准装备

desc.en-us: Portable gas tanks store gas. To refill one, bolt it to a Kit (Tank Connector), then connect it to a pipe network. Try to avoid pushing it above 10 MPa, or bad things happen. Once it's full, you can refill a Canister by attaching it to the tank's striped section. Or you could vent the tank's variable flow rate valve into a room and create an atmosphere.
desc.zh-hans: 便携储罐专门用来存储气体. 将其固定在 (套件)储罐连接器 并接入管道网络即可充气. 请勿使压力超过10MPa, 否则后果堪忧. 充满后, 可将 储气瓶 放入罐体条纹区域进行分装. 也可以开启罐体上的流速阀向舱室释放气体以营造大气环境

desc.en-us: Every Stationeer's best friend, the portable generator gets you up and running, fast. Fill it with a Canister (Fuel) to power up and charge a Battery Cell (Small), or attach it to a Power Connector to link it into your electrical network. It's pressure driven, so functions more efficiently at lower temperatures, and REALLY efficiently if supercooled. Perfecting your fuel mix also makes a big difference.
desc.zh-hans: 作为每位 Stationeer's 的最佳伙伴, 便携式发电机能让您快速运转起来. 装入 储气瓶(燃料) 即可为 电池(小) 充电, 或连接至 便携式发电机连接器 并接入电网. 该设备采用压力驱动, 低温环境下效率更高, 超低温时效能显著提升. 优化燃料混合比例也能大幅改善其性能

desc.en-us: Philippe Starck might not applaud, but this battery-powered light source undarkens the corners when illumination's lacking. Powered by any battery, it's a 'no-frills' Xigo design that can be cheaply fabricated with the minimum of fuss. Unless you like fuss. In which case, fuss all you like.
desc.zh-hans: 菲利普·斯塔克或许看不上这东西, 但这款电池供电光源能在照明不足时能够帮助驱散黑暗角落. 兼容任意电池供电, 采用源于 Xigo 的极简风格设计, 无需繁琐操作即可低成本制造——除非您偏好复杂的加工工序, 那还是另想办法吧

desc.en-us: This portable tank stores liquid. You can bolt one to a Portables Connector using a Wrench, then connect it to a pipe network to refill it. You can refill a Liquid Canister by attaching it to the tank's striped section.
desc.zh-hans: 这款便携储罐用于储存液体. 您可以使用 扳手 将其固定到 便携式连接器 上, 再连接至 液体管道(直线) 并为管道网络供应液体. 请将压力控制在10MPa以下, 否则您将在痛苦和懊悔中浑身湿透. 可将 储液瓶 放入罐体条纹区域进行分装.

desc.en-us: This portable tank stores liquid and is fully insulated. You can bolt one to a Portables Connector using a Wrench, then connect it to a pipe network to refill it. You can refill a Liquid Canister by attaching it to the tank's striped section.
desc.zh-hans: 这款便携储罐用于储存液体, 并且完全隔绝热量. 您可以使用 扳手 将其固定到 便携式连接器 上, 再连接至管道网络对其进行加注. 可将 储液瓶 放入罐体条纹区域进行分装.

desc.en-us: When attached to a Payload Bay Large the Payload Delivery Container can be deployed in Low Orbit to drop supplies to any location on the map.
desc.zh-hans: 当挂载到 大型载荷舱 时, 载荷投送容器舱 可在低轨道展开, 并向地图上的任意位置投放补给品.

desc.en-us: A portable scrubber does just what it sounds like: removes specific substances from the air. For instance, attaching a Filter (Carbon Dioxide) will pull Carbon Dioxide from the surrounding atmosphere. Note that the scrubber has room for one battery and two filters, which will double its operating speed. Neat. When it reaches an internal pressure of 8106kPA, an error signal will flash on the switch, indicating it needs to be emptied. Either vent it directly, or attach it to a pipe network via a Kit (Tank Connector) and a Wrench.
desc.zh-hans: 便携式空气过滤器的功能如其名: 清除空气中的特定物质. 例如安装 滤芯(二氧化碳) 可吸附周围环境中的 二氧化碳 . 该设备配备1个电池槽和2个过滤器槽, 双过滤器可使运行速度翻倍. 当内部压力达到8106千帕时, 开关将闪烁错误信号提示清空. 可将其直接排放, 或通过 (套件)储罐连接器 和 扳手 连接至管道网络处理

desc.en-us: This device is deprecated. Use the Combustor instead.
desc.zh-hans: 燃烧器用于在可控状态下燃烧可燃气体. 如果向其输入 氢气 和 氧气 , 它能够输出 水蒸汽 ,并在充分冷却之后用于饮用和水培农业.

desc.en-us:
The advanced Xigo Padi 2 tablet is an improved version of the basic Handheld Tablet, boasting two cartridge slots. The Padi 2 accepts Cartridge (Atmos Analyzer), Cartridge (Tracker), Cartridge (Medical Analyzer), Cartridge (Ore Scanner), Cartridge (eReader), and various other cartridges.

With a Integrated Circuit (IC10) in the Programmable Chip, you can access variable slots on the carrying human using the device numbers (d0, d1, etc...), so long as the item can be access via logic, such as the Hardsuit.
desc.zh-hans:
Xigo Padi2高级平板是基础 平板电脑 的升级版, 配备两个 功能卡 插槽, 支持 功能卡(大气分析) 、 功能卡(定位) 、 功能卡(医疗分析) 、 功能卡(矿石扫描) 、 功能卡(电子书) 等类型.
在 可编程芯片 槽位安装 芯片(IC10) 后, 可通过设备编号（d0、d1等）访问穿戴者的逻辑可交互物品（如 强化太空服 ）变量槽

desc.en-us: Angles-be-gone with the trusty angle grinder.
desc.zh-hans: 角磨机——消除棱角的可靠工具

desc.en-us:
Harnessing a design pioneered in the early 21st century, the small battery cell is the Stationeer's basic unit of portable electrical power. While it lacks the charge of a Battery Cell (Large) or Battery Cell (Nuclear), it has the humble advantage of being fabricated from basic resources.

POWER OUTPUT
The small cell stores up to 36000 watts of power.
desc.zh-hans:
采用21世纪初开创的设计, 小型电池是 Stationeer 便携式电力的基础单元. 虽然电量不及 电池(大) 或 电池(核能) , 但具有用基础资源制造的朴素优势.
电力输出
小型电池最多可储存36000瓦电力

desc.en-us:
First mass-produced by Xigo in 2155 on the basis of a unattributed prototype, the classic silicon anode solid-state design extends its optimum temperature range.

POWER OUTPUT
The large power cell can discharge 288kW of power.
desc.zh-hans:
基于未署名的原型设计,  Xigo 公司于2155年首次大规模生产. 经典硅阳极固态设计扩展了其最佳温度范围.
电力输出
大型电池最多可释放28kW电力

desc.en-us:
Illegal on Earth since the Chengdu Event, Norsec nuclear power cells found a new and drastically less safety-conscious market offworld.

POWER OUTPUT
Pushing the power-weight balance to its limits, the 'nuke' has a 2.3 megawatt charge (2304000W), reflecting its reliance on exotic superalloys.
desc.zh-hans:
自成都事件后在地球被禁用的Norsec核电池, 在太空找到了安全意识淡薄的新市场.
电力输出
将功重比推向极限的"核电池"拥有2. 3兆瓦（2304000W）电量, 这得益于 超级合金 的特性

desc.en-us: A container for a Burger that is both asethetic and practical as it will significantly reduce the decay rate. Will directly allow the eating of contained food when opened in hands.
desc.zh-hans: 用于存放 汉堡包 的容器, 兼顾美观与实用性, 能显著降低食物腐烂速度. 拿在手上并开启时可直接食用其中的食物.

desc.en-us: Overalls that can be coloured using the Spray Paints.

The ExMin Off-whirled Hand Drill has been a companion to Stationeers for decades. Essential for assembling and deconstructing various items and structures, regardless of gravity, pressure or temperature.
desc.zh-hans: 埃克斯明 牌"异星"手钻数十年来始终是 Stationeers 的忠实伙伴. 无论重力、气压或温度如何, 皆是组装与解构各类物品设施的必备工具

desc.en-us: Within, eggs reside in mysterious, marmoreal silence.
desc.zh-hans: 蛋类静驻其中, 笼罩在神秘的大理石一般沉寂里

desc.en-us: The EVA suit is the basic suit Stationeers need to survive in the inhospitable environment of space. For more information on EVA suits, consult the EVA suit guide.
desc.zh-hans: 太空服是 Stationeer 在恶劣太空环境中生存的基础装备. 更多信息请参阅 太空服 指南

desc.en-us: A flashlight with a narrow and wide beam options.
desc.zh-hans: 配备聚光/泛光双模式切换功能的手持照明设备

desc.en-us: This mask will mix with the world atmosphere but filter out the gasses based on the filters in its two slots.
desc.zh-hans: 此面罩可与外界气体混合, 并根据两个过滤槽的滤芯选择性过滤有害气体

desc.en-us:
The CryoSurge Hand-Held Radio offers a solution to the problem of long distance communications.
Any radio's boosted by a Radio Tower will be able to transmit & receive on the same channel even if they're on a different world, universe or galaxy.
Radio passive power usage: 10W
Radio active power usage : 100W
This backpack can be useful when you are working inside and don't need to fly around.
desc.zh-hans: 在无需飞行作业的场景中, 此背包非常实用

desc.en-us:
The Norsec jetpack isn't 'technically' a jetpack at all, it's a gas thruster. It can be powered by any gas, so long as the internal pressure of the canister is higher than the ambient external pressure. If the external pressure is greater, the spacepack will not function. Adjusting the thrust value alters your rate of acceleration, while activating the stablizer causes the spacepack to hover when a given height is reached.
The hardsuit jetpack is capable of much higher speeds than the Jetpack Basic - up to 15m/s. Indispensable for building, mining and general movement, it has fourteen storage slots.
USE: 'J' to activate; 'space' to fly up; 'left ctrl' to descend; and 'WASD' to move.
desc.zh-hans:
Norsec 喷气背包从"技术上"来说不是喷气背包, 而是气体推进器. 只要 canister 内部气压高于外部环境压力, 即可使用任何气体作为动力. 若外部压力更高, 空间背包将无法运作. 调整推力值可改变加速度, 激活稳定器后可在特定高度悬停.
此款强化喷气背包速度远超 基础喷气背包 （最高达15米/秒）, 是建造、采矿和移动的必备工具, 提供14个存储槽.
使用方式: 'J'激活；空格键上升；左Ctrl下降；WASD移动

desc.en-us: Connects to Logic Transmitter
The Hardsuit Helmet is similar to the Space Helmet, but can withstand higher temperatures and pressures. It's perfect for enduring harsh environments like Venus and Vulcan.
desc.zh-hans: 与 太空头盔 类似, 但能承受更高温度和压力. 适用于金星、伏尔甘等恶劣环境

desc.en-us:
The basic CHAC jetpack isn't 'technically' a jetpack, it's a gas thruster. It can be powered by any gas, so long as the internal pressure of the canister is higher than the ambient external pressure. If the external pressure is greater, the spacepack will not function.
Indispensable for building, mining and general movement, it has ten storage slots and lets Stationeers fly at 3m/s, compared to the more powerful Hardsuit Jetpack. Adjusting the thrust value alters your rate of acceleration, while activating the stabilizer causes the spacepack to hover when a given height is reached.
USE: 'J' to activate; 'space' to fly up; 'left ctrl' to descend; and 'WASD' to move.
desc.zh-hans: 这款 CHAC 基础背包'技术上'来说并非背包, 而是气体推进装置. 只要 气瓶 内部压力高于环境压力即可工作（外部压力过高时失效）. 具备10个储物槽, 使 太空工程师 能以3m/s飞行（弱于 强化喷气背包 ）, 适用于建造、采矿和移动. 调节推力值能够改变加速度, 启用稳定器可在达到指定高度时悬停. 操作: J键启动, 空格上升, 左Ctrl下降, WASD移动

desc.en-us: A labeller lets you set names and values on a variety of devices and structures, including Console and Logic.
desc.zh-hans: 允许你在各种设备和结构（包括 控制台 和 Logic ）上设置名称和数值

desc.en-us:
The Laptop functions as a portable IC editor. To operate the Laptop it must be powered with a battery, have a IC Editor Motherboard in the motherboard slot, and an Integrated Circuit (IC10) in the Programmable Chip Slot.

You must place the laptop down to interact with the onsreen UI.
desc.zh-hans:
笔记本电脑可作为便携式集成电路编辑器, 需安装电池供电, 主板插槽插入 主板(IC编辑器) , 可编程芯片槽放置 芯片(IC10) 方可运行.

需放置于平面后通过屏幕界面操作

desc.en-us: When set to Inwards mode the Liquid Vacuum removes liquid from the world and into its internal tank. When set to outwards mode it empties its internal tank back into the world. Empty it over Passive Liquid Inlet to get your liquid back into a pipe.
desc.zh-hans: 向内模式时,  液体清扫器 会将液体吸入内部储罐；向外模式时则将液体排出. 可对准 被动排液口 排放以回收液体至管道

desc.en-us: Angles-be-gone with the trusty angle grinder. The MK II is more resistant to temperature and pressure.
desc.zh-hans: 可靠的角度消除工具. MKII更耐高温高压

操作: 'J'启动；'空格'上升；'左Ctrl'下降；'WASD'移动. "

desc.en-us:
The ODA does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions.
As such, Stationeers have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure.
Central to this pastime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops.

DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED

1: Connect 8 Device Step Units to your step sequencer via the data port on the left hand side.

2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdriver.

3: Select the output speaker (eg Passive Speaker) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the right hand side of the sequencer.

4: Place a Stop Watch and use a Logic Reader and Logic Writer to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer.

5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a Dial and a Logic Writer to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster.

6: Insert a sound cartridge of your choosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartridge slot.

7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive).

8: Get freaky with the Low frequency oscillator.

9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.
desc.zh-hans:
ODA 不认可原声音乐或其他干扰因素.
因此,  Stationeers 不得不在建造和维护外星基础设施的繁重劳动中创造自己的音乐伴奏.
这一消遣的核心是步进音序器, 它允许Stationeers编排简短的音乐模式或循环.

自制音乐-入门指南

1:通过左侧数据端口将8个 步进音序单元 连接到步进音序器.

2:标记每个步进单元, 然后用螺丝刀在音序器上分配1至8号步进单元.

3:选择音序器播放声音的输出扬声器（例如 扬声器 ）. 需将其连接到音序器右侧的逻辑网络.

4:放置 码表 , 使用 逻辑读取 和 逻辑写入 将时间写入音序器的时间变量.

5:用 旋钮 和 逻辑写入 设置音序器的BPM变量. 更高BPM会使序列播放更快.

6:插入所选音色卡带, 通过卡带槽上下方的箭头按钮选择要播放的声音变体.

7:通过设置8个步进单元上的旋钮选择音高. 鼓声模式下, 每个音符对应不同鼓声. 可通过点击步进单元的激活按钮试听（音序器需处于未激活状态）.

8:用 低频振荡器 制造迷幻效果.

9:最后, 激活音序器, 开启太空律动

A simple composting device, the basic composter creates Fertilizer out of organic matter. It accepts food, Decayed Food or Biomass. It requires a full Liquid Canister and a battery to operate, accelerating the natural composting process.
When processing, it releases nitrogen and Methane, as well a small amount of heat.

Compost composition
Fertilizer is produced at a 1:3 ratio of fertilizer to ingredients. The fertilizer's effects on plants will vary depending on the respective proportions of its ingredients.

- food increases PLANT YIELD up to two times
- Decayed Food increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to two times
- Biomass increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for

Designed by - presumably drunk - Norsec roboticists, AIMeE (or Automated Independent Mechanical Entity) can be a Stationeer's best friend, or tiresome nemesis, or both several times in the same day.

Intended to unearth and retrieve ores automatically, the unit requires basic programming knowledge to operate, and IC Editor Motherboard.

AIMEe has 7 modes:

RobotMode.None = 0 = Do nothing
RobotMode.None = 1 = Follow nearest player
RobotMode.None = 2 = Move to target in straight line
RobotMode.None = 3 = Wander around looking for ores in 15 co-ords radius
RobotMode.None = 4 = Unload in chute input or chute bin within 3 meters / 1.5 large grids
RobotMode.None = 5 = Path(find) to target
RobotMode.None = 6 = Automatic assigned state, shows when storage slots are full

0=待机
1=跟随最近玩家
2=直线移动至目标
3=15坐标半径内游荡寻矿

desc.en-us:
Built using the Kit (Atmospherics), the ExMin-designed air conditioner is used to raise or lower input gas temperature.

The unit has three pipe connections: input, output, and waste. Gas fed into the input will be heated or cooled to reach the target temperature, while the opposite will happen to gas on the waste network.

Multiple Efficiency Multipliers can effect the amount of energy the Air Conditioner uses, and these can be view on the unit's green Information Panel. As the temperature difference between input and waste increases, the Temperature Differential Efficiency Multiplier will decrease. If input or waste temperature is extremely hot or cold, the Operational Temperature Efficiency will decrease. If the input or waste pipe has approach low pressures, the Pressure Efficiency will decrease.

Pipe Convection Radiators may be useful in bringing extreme pipe temperatures back towards normal world temperatures.

For more information on using the air conditioner, consult the temperature control Guides page.
desc.zh-hans:
使用 (套件)气体设备 建造的 ExMin设计 空调机用于升高或降低输入气体温度.
该设备有三个管道接口: 输入口、输出口和废气口. 输入口的气体将被加热或冷却以达到目标温度, 而废气口连接的管道网络中的气体将发生相反的温度变化.
多个效率乘数会影响空调机的能耗, 这些参数可在设备的绿色信息面板查看. 随着输入与废气管温差增大, 温差效率乘数会降低. 若输入或废气管温度极高/极低, 运行温度效率也会下降. 若输入或废气管压力过低, 压力效率会降低.
管道散热器 有助于将极端管道温度调节至正常环境温度.
更多使用说明请参考 温控 指南页面. "

desc.en-us: The standard airlock is a powered portal that forms the main component of an airlock chamber. As long as the airlock is not locked, it can be manually opened using a crowbar.
desc.zh-hans: 标准气闸门是构成气闸室主体的动力门户. 气闸门未锁定时可使用撬棍手动开启

desc.en-us: 1 x 1 modular door piece for building hangar doors.
desc.zh-hans: 1×1模块化门组件, 用于建造机库门

desc.en-us:
The simplest smelting system available to the average Stationeer, Recurso's arc furnace was forged itself in the depths of the Solar System to help explorational geologists determine the purity of potential asteroidal mining targets.
Co-opted by the ODA, it now provides Stationeers with a way to produce pure ingots of various resources.
The smelting process also releases a range of by product gases, principally Nitrogen, Carbon Dioxide, Methane and Oxygen in differing ratios. These can be recaptured from the atmosphere by filtering, but also make the arc furnace a risk in closed environments.
Unlike the more advanced Furnace, the arc furnace cannot create alloys.
desc.zh-hans:
作为普通 Stationeer 最易获取的冶炼设备,  Recurso 电弧炉诞生于太阳系深处, 原为勘探地质学家检测小行星矿藏纯度设计.
现被 ODA 改造用于生产纯金属锭. 冶炼过程会释放 气体 副产物(主要为不同比例的 氮气 、 二氧化碳 、 甲烷 和 氧气 ), 需过滤回收且在密闭环境中存在风险.
注: 无法像先进 熔炉 那样制造 合金

desc.en-us:
An Area Power Control (APC) has three main functions:
Its primary purpose is to regulate power flow, ensuring uninterrupted performance from devices and machinery, especially those with a fluctuating draw.
APCs also create sub-networks, as no devices on the far side of an APC are visible on the main network.
Lastly, an APC charges batteries, which can provide backup power to the sub-network in the case of an outage. Note that an APC requires a battery to stabilize power draw. It also has two variants, each allowing power to flow in one direction only.
desc.zh-hans:
"区域电源控制器（APC）具有三大功能:
主要功能是调节电力流动, 确保设备与机械（尤其是功耗波动的设备）持续运行.
APC可创建子电网, 因APC远端设备在主电网不可见.
最后, APC可为电池充电, 在断电时为子电网提供备用电源. 注意: APC需要电池来稳定电力消耗. 另有两种变体, 每种仅允许单向电流. "

desc.en-us: The Recurso SquareDig autominer is a structure that when built will mine a vertical 2x2 shaft until it hits bedrock. The autominer can be connected to a chute system, and is controllable by a logic network. Note that the autominer outputs more ore than a conventional Mining Drill over the same area.
desc.zh-hans: Recurso SquareDig自动矿机可垂直挖掘大小为2x2的竖井直至基岩层. 可连接滑槽系统并通过逻辑网络控制, 相同区域产出 矿石 量超过传统 采矿钻机

desc.en-us: The foundation of most Stationeer fabrication systems, the ExMin autolathe is a multi-axis molecular compositional system. Its complexity demands considerable time to assemble, but it remains an indispensable creation tool. Upgrade the device using a Autolathe Printer Mod for additional recipes and faster processing speeds.
desc.zh-hans: 作为Stationeer制造体系的核心,  ExMin 自动车床采用多轴分子重组技术, 组装耗时但功能不可或缺. 安装 自动车床改装件 可解锁更多配方并提升处理速度

desc.en-us: Regulates the volume ratio of liquid in the input Liquid pipe. This is expressed as percentage where 100 is totally full and 0 is empty.
desc.zh-hans: 调节输入液体管道的容积比率（百分比, 100为全满, 0为空）

desc.en-us: Unlike the Pressure Regulator, which closes when the input exceeds a given pressure, the back pressure regulator opens when input pressure reaches a given value.
desc.zh-hans: 与 压力调节器 在输入超压时关闭不同, 背压调节器在输入压力达到设定值时开启

desc.en-us:
Providing large-scale, reliable power storage, the Sinotai 'Dianzi' station battery is the heart of most Stationeer bases.
There are a variety of cautions to the design of electrical systems using batteries, and every experienced Stationeer has a story to tell, hence the Stationeer adage: 'Dianzi cooks, but it also frys.'
POWER OUTPUT
Able to store up to 3600000W of power, there are no practical limits to its throughput, hence it is wise to use Cable Coil (Heavy). Seasoned electrical engineers will also laugh in the face of those who fail to separate out their power generation networks using an Area Power Control and Transformer (Large).
desc.zh-hans:
作为大多数 Stationeer 基地的核心,  Sinotai 「电子」站用蓄电池提供大规模可靠电力存储.
使用蓄电池设计电力系统需注意诸多事项, 每位Stationeer都有故事可讲, 因此流传着这样的谚语: 「电子能烹饪, 但也会煎炸. 」
电力输出
可存储高达3600000瓦电力, 其吞吐量无实际限制, 因此建议使用 重型电缆 . 经验丰富的电气工程师会嘲笑那些未使用 区域电源控制器 和 变压器(大型) 隔离发电网络的人

desc.en-us: The 5-slot Xigo battery charger fits the Battery Cell (Small), Battery Cell (Large) and Battery Cell (Nuclear), providing up to 500W to any connected cell. Note: the older design means this device has minor power draw (10W) even when not charging.
desc.zh-hans: 这款5槽位 Xigo 充电器适配 电池(小) 、 电池(大) 和 电池(核能) , 为连接电池提供每槽位最高500瓦的充电功率. 注意: 旧款设计使该设备即使未充电时也有微量功耗（10瓦）

desc.en-us:
Providing even better large-scale, reliable power storage than the Station Battery, the Sinotai 'Da Dianchi' large station battery is the heart of most Stationeer bases.
There are a variety of cautions to the design of electrical systems using batteries, and every experienced Stationeer has a story to tell, hence the Stationeer adage: 'Dianzi cooks, but it also frys.'
POWER OUTPUT
Able to store up to 9000001 watts of power, there are no practical limits to its throughput, hence it is wise to use Cable Coil (Heavy). Seasoned electrical engineers will also laugh in the face of those who fail to separate out their power generation networks using an Area Power Control and Transformer (Large).
desc.zh-hans:
Sinotai 「大电池」大型站用蓄电池能够提供比 蓄电池 更强大的储能, 是 Stationeer 的核心设备. 需注意电路设计（老手常言: 「电子会烹饪, 也会煎炸」）
电力输出
存能上限9000001瓦, 无输出功率限制.
建议使用 重型电缆 电缆, 并通过 区域电源控制器 和 变压器(大型) 隔离发电网络

desc.en-us: When it's time to sit, nothing supports you like a bench. This bench is powered, so you can use appliances like the Microwave.
desc.zh-hans: 当需要坐下时, 没有什么比长凳更能支撑你. 此长凳已通电, 可使用 微波炉 等电器

desc.en-us:
Airtight and almost undamageable, the original 'Millmar' series of blast door was designed by off-world mining giant Recurso to protect asteroid-mining facilities from nuclear-incident-level explosive decompression.
Short of a pocket-sized singularity blinking into the local space-time frame, there is effectively no limit to the pressure these blast doors can contain - ideal for constructing airlocks in pressure-sensitive environments.
desc.zh-hans:
气密且几乎不可摧毁的初代「米尔玛」防爆门由外星矿业巨头 Recurso 设计, 用于保护小行星采矿设施免受核事故级爆炸减压影响.
除非局部时空出现口袋奇点, 这些防爆门能承受的压力实际上没有上限——是压力敏感环境建造气闸室的理想选择

desc.en-us:
Nothing says 'I care' like a security camera that's been linked a Motion Sensor and a Console fitted with a Camera Display.
Be there, even when you're not.
desc.zh-hans:
将安防摄像头与 运动传感器 和装有 电路板(监控摄像) 的 控制台 连接, 最能体现「我在乎」.
即使你不在场, 也能随时关注

desc.en-us:
If a Recycler or unbalanced Furnace outputs reagent mixture rather than the desired ingots, a centrifuge allows you to reclaim the raw ore.
It also refines Dirty Ore produced from the Deep Miner and Dirty Ore produced from the Rocket Miner.
Its bigger brother Combustion Centrifuge can be used to process items significantly faster. Items processed by the centrifuge will be de-gassed.
If openned while powered on, the centrifuge will enter an errored state and reduce its rpm to 0 and then export any items.
desc.zh-hans:
若 回收站 或材料未平衡的 熔炉 输出 原料 混合物而非所需的 金属锭 时, 离心机可将其回收为原始 矿石 .
可精炼 深层采矿机 产生的 粗矿石 和 火箭采矿机 产生的 未精炼矿石 .
其升级版 燃气式离心机 能显著加快处理速度. 离心机处理的物品将完全脱气.
若在启动时打开, 离心机会进入错误状态, 转速降至0并弹出所有物品

desc.zh-hans: 宇宙中众多椅子之一, 专为具有0到2条上肢的双足生物优化

desc.en-us:
The Stationeer's goal is to make off-world survival less of a struggle for themselves, and those who will follow in their footsteps.
Like most Recurso-designed systems, chute bins are simple and robust powered items, allowing items to be manually passed into chute networks by pulling a lever. They can also be programmed with logic to operate automatically, although full automation requires the use items such as a SDB Hopper.

desc.en-us:
The Combustion Centrifuge is a gas fuel powered version of the Centrifuge. If a Recycler or unbalanced Furnace outputs reagent mixture rather than the desired ingots, a centrifuge allows you to reclaim the raw ore.
It also refines Dirty Ore produced from the Deep Miner and Dirty Ore produced from the Rocket Miner. A combustible fuel mix should be supplied to the gas input, and waste gasses should be vented from the output.
The machine's RPMs must be controlled via the throttle and combustion limiter levers. If the Combustion Centrifuge gains, or loses, RPMs too fast it will experience stress, and eventually grind to a halt.  Higher RPMs directly result in faster processing speeds.
The throttle lever controls the amount of fuel being pulled into the machine, increasing the temperature inside the engine, and leading to an increase in RPM. The limiter lever influences the speed of the combustion, and how much uncombusted gas is in the exhaust.
Ejecting ore from the Combustion Centrifuge while it is at high RPMs will result in additional stress build up.  If turned off while not stressed, the machine will automatically start to brake, and reduce RPMs in a controlled manner.
desc.zh-hans:
使用燃料气体作为动力的离心机, 可处理 回收站 或配比失败 熔炉 输出的 材料混合物 , 回收 原矿 . 同时能够精炼 深层采矿机 产出的 粗矿石 和 火箭采矿机 产出的 未精炼矿石 .

需要供给燃料气体至进气口, 燃烧后的废气从排气口排出. 通过节流阀档位杆与内燃限制器档位杆控制转速, 转速变化过快会导致压应力逐渐累积直至完全停转. 提高转速能够同步提升矿石处理效率.

节流阀档位控制燃料供给量, 并影响内部温度与转速, 内燃限制器档位杆调节燃烧速度与废气残留量. 高转速状态下弹出矿石将立刻增加压应力. 如果在无应力状态下关机, 会自动减速并刹停

desc.en-us:
The Combustion Deep Miner is a gas fuel powered version of the Deep Miner. The machine's RPMs must be controlled via the throttle and combustion limiter levers. If the Combustion Deep Miner gains, or loses, RPMs too fast it will experience stress, and eventually grind to a halt.
Higher RPMs directly result in faster mining speeds.
The throttle lever controls the amount of fuel being pulled into the machine, increasing the temperature inside the engine, and leading to an increase in RPM.
The limiter lever influences the speed of the combustion, and how much uncombusted gas is in the exhaust.
Turning the machine off will reduce RPMs in a controlled manner.
desc.zh-hans:
燃气式深层采矿机是 深层采矿机 的燃气动力版本. 这台矿机的转速必须通过节流阀档位杆和内燃限位器档位杆进行控制. 如果燃气式深层采矿机的转速(RPM)变化过快, 它将承受压应力, 并最终完全停止运转.
更高的转速能够直接带来更快的采矿速度.
节流阀档位杆控制进入机器的燃料量, 从而提高内置发动机的温度, 并使转速增加.
内燃限位器影响燃烧速度以及废气中未燃尽气体的含量.
直接关闭机器时, 转速将会以可控方式下降.

desc.en-us: Recurso's composite doors are rated to 300kPa, which is more than sufficient for most purposes they were designed for. However, steep pressure differentials are not your friend.
desc.zh-hans: Recurso 复合门额定承压300kPa, 完全满足设计用途需求. 但需注意剧烈压差仍具危险性

desc.en-us: This unit operates with a wide range of motherboards.
desc.zh-hans: 该设备支持多种 主板 运行

desc.en-us: This unit operates with a wide range of motherboards.
desc.zh-hans: 该设备兼容多种 motherboards 主板运行

desc.en-us:
A device for safely condensing gasses into liquids. Liquids and Gasses will both exist safely inside the device. The Chamber will pressurise using its in-built pressure regulator to the target set by the setting wheel.
The secondary gas input on the left is a heat-exchanger input and allows for heat exchange between the secondary input pipe and the internal atmosphere of the Condensation Chamber.
Paired with Evaporation Chamber Stationeers can exploit the phase change properties of gases to build a DIY air conditioner.
desc.zh-hans:
一种安全将气体冷凝为液体的装置. 液体和气体均可安全存在于装置内部. 该容器通过内置压力调节器将内部压力维持在使用设置轮设定的目标值.
左侧的次级气体输入口是热交换接口, 允许次级输入管道与冷凝器内部气体进行热交换.
配合 蒸发器 使用, 太空工程师可利用气体的相变特性建造自制空调系统

desc.en-us: Allows for the removal of any liquids from a gas pipe into a liquid pipe. Only allows liquids to pass in one direction.
desc.zh-hans: 允许将气体管道中的液体转移至液体管道. 仅允许液体单向通过

desc.en-us:
This control box manages devices such as the Active Vent, Gas Sensor and Composite Door, depending on which circuitboard is inserted into the unit. It has a shared data/power port.
A completed console displays all devices connected to the current power network. Any devices not related to the installed circuitboard will be greyed-out and inoperable. To enter setup mode, use a  Screwdriver on the screw on the side of the Console.
desc.zh-hans:
这款控制台可管理 主动通风口 , 气体传感器 和 复合门 等设备（具体取决于插入的 电路板 类型）, 配备复合数据/电源接口.
完整组装的控制台会显示当前电网所有连接设备. 与当前电路板无关的设备将显示为灰色且不可操作. 要进入设置模式, 需要使用螺丝刀 拧 控制台 侧面的螺丝.

desc.en-us: This Norsec-designed control box manages devices such as the Active Vent, Passive Vent, Gas Sensor and Composite Door, depending on which circuitboard is inserted into the unit. It has a shared data/power port. A completed console displays all devices connected to the current power network. Any devices not related to the installed circuitboard will be greyed-out and inoperable. Consoles are locked once a Data Disk is removed.

This Norsec-designed control box manages devices such as the Active Vent, Passive Vent, Gas Sensor and Composite Door, depending on which circuitboard is inserted into the unit. It has a shared data/power port. A completed console displays all devices connected to the current power network. Any devices not related to the installed circuitboard will be greyed-out and inoperable. Consoles are locked once a Data Disk is removed.

This control box manages devices such as the Active Vent, Gas Sensor, Composite Door and others, depending on which circuitboard is inserted into the unit. It has separate data and power ports.
A completed console displays all devices connected to the current power network. Any devices not related to the installed circuitboard will be greyed-out and inoperable. Consoles are locked once a Data Disk is removed.
desc.zh-hans:
这款控制台可管理 主动通风口 , 气体传感器 和 复合门 等设备（具体取决于插入的 电路板 类型）, 配备独立数据和电源接口.
完整组装的控制台会显示当前电网所有连接设备. 与当前电路板无关的设备将显示为灰色且不可操作. 要进入设置模式, 需要使用螺丝刀 拧 控制台 侧面的螺丝.

desc.en-us: This LED console normally displays the raw numeric value of its setting. When you switch to String Mode, it treats that value as up to six ASCII characters, each packed in one byte by repeated 8-bit shifts and OR operations and renders them as text. Other modes offer alternative visualizations of the same underlying value.
desc.zh-hans: 此LED显示屏通常显示其设置的原始数值. 当切换至字符串模式时, 它会将数值解析为最多六字节的ASCII字符(每个字符通过反复的8位移位和按位或(OR)运算单字节封装), 并将其以文本方式显示. 其他模式则提供对同一底层数值的多样化展示方式.

desc.en-us:
This control box manages devices such as the Active Vent, Passive Vent, Gas Sensor, Security Camera and Composite Door, depending on which circuitboard is inserted into the unit. It has a shared data/power port, and a charming sloped interface.
A completed console displays all devices connected to the current power network. Any devices not related to the installed circuitboard will be greyed-out and inoperable. Consoles are locked once a Data Disk is removed.
desc.zh-hans:
这款控制台可管理 主动通风口 , 气体传感器 和 复合门 等设备（具体取决于插入的 电路板 类型）, 配备复合数据/电源接口.
完整组装的控制台会显示当前电网所有连接设备. 与当前电路板无关的设备将显示为灰色且不可操作. 要进入设置模式, 需要使用螺丝刀 拧 控制台 侧面的螺丝.

desc.en-us: Seat for crewing a rocket. While the seat is occupied the rocket can only travel between launch mounts, and the seat can only be exited while the rocket is landed on one.

The exact operation of the Longsleep cryotube remains a commercial secret, with Norsec merely licensing the design. A pipe connection is provided to maintain suitable internal atmosphere connected to the occupant via breathing tubes. When the liquid pipe connection is supplied super cooled Liquid Nitrogen occupants will regenerate organs and even revive if deceased. Nothing can be worn when entering the device.
desc.zh-hans: 长眠冷冻舱的具体操作方式仍属商业机密, Norsec公司仅授权设计许可. 该设备提供管道接口, 通过呼吸管道维持使用者所需的内部大气环境; 当液体管道接入超冷的液氮时, 可以修复使用者的器官损伤, 甚至可复活死亡状态的使用者. 进入该设备时禁止穿戴任何装备.

desc.en-us: The exact operation of the Longsleep cryotube remains a commercial secret, with Norsec merely licensing the design. A pipe connection is provided to maintain suitable internal atmosphere connected to the occupant via breathing tubes. When the liquid pipe connection is supplied super cooled Liquid Nitrogen occupants will regenerate organs and even revive if deceased. Nothing can be worn when entering the device.
desc.zh-hans: 长眠冷冻舱的具体操作方式仍属商业机密, Norsec公司仅授权设计许可. 该设备提供管道接口, 通过呼吸管道维持使用者所需的内部大气环境; 当液体管道接入超冷的液氮时, 可以修复使用者的器官损伤, 甚至可复活死亡状态的使用者. 进入该设备时禁止穿戴任何装备.

desc.en-us: Daylight sensors provide data on whether the current region of your base is in sunlight, and report the exact solar angle. Note that the orientation of the sensor alters the reported solar angle, while Logic systems can be used to offset it.
desc.zh-hans: 日光传感器可检测基地当前区域是否处于日照中, 并报告精确太阳角度. 注意传感器朝向会影响报告角度, 可通过 逻辑系统 进行偏移校准

desc.en-us: Drills through terrain until it hits bedrock. Once inside bedrock Dirty Ore is produced roughly every 90s. The type of ore mined will vary by location, you can read the make-up of ore mined at any position using the Cartridge (Deep Miner)
desc.zh-hans: 钻探岩层设备, 钻头触及基岩后能够以约90秒的间隔产出 粗矿石

desc.en-us: The digital valve allows Stationeers to create logic-controlled valves and pipe networks.
desc.zh-hans: 数控阀允许 Stationeers 创建 逻辑控制 的阀门和管道网络

desc.en-us: The Drinking Fountain can be interacted with directly to increase hydration. It needs a Water supply.
desc.zh-hans: 可直接交互并增加饮水值的装置, 需要为其供应 水

desc.en-us: The Norsec-designed Electrolyzer splits Water into hydrogen and Oxygen. Employing unknown proprietary technology, the device uses water's latent heat as the energy to drive the electrosis process. If there is a downside to this near-miraculous fission, it's that the device is limited by the quantity of power available, which is used to maintain the temperature output. In other words, the machine works best with hot gas.
desc.zh-hans: Norsec 电解机将 水 分解为氢气和 氧气 , 利用水的潜热驱动电解过程. 设备效能受供电量限制（电力用于维持温度输出）, 所以在高温气体环境下运行能得到最佳效率

desc.en-us: The electronic printer will create any electronic part you need. From circuit boards and electronic devices to solar panels. The choice is yours. Upgrade the device using a Electronic Printer Mod for additional recipes and faster processing speeds.
desc.zh-hans: 电子打印机可制造各类 电子部件 , 包括电路板、电子设备及太阳能板. 安装 电子打印机改装件 可解锁更多配方并提升处理速度

desc.en-us:
A device for safely evaporating liquids into gasses. Liquids and Gasses will both exist safely inside the device. Lowering the pressure target of the in-built back pressure regulator using the setting wheel will change the boiling temperature of liquids inside.
The secondary gas input on the left is a heat-exchanger input and allows for heat exchange between the secondary input pipe and the internal atmosphere of the Evaporation Chamber.
Paired with Condensation Chamber Stationeers can exploit the phase change properties of gases to build a DIY air conditioner.
desc.zh-hans:
一种安全将液体蒸发为气体的装置. 液体和气体均可安全存在于装置内部. 使用设置轮降低内置背压调节器的压力目标值, 可改变内部液体的沸点温度.
左侧的次级气体输入口是热交换接口, 允许次级输入管道与蒸发器内部气体进行热交换.
配合 冷凝器 使用, Stationeers可利用气体的相变特性建造自制空调系统

desc.en-us: Allows for moving liquids from a liquid pipe into a gas pipe. Only allows liquids to pass in one direction. Typically this is done to allow the liquid to evaporate into a gas as part of an airconditioning loop.
desc.zh-hans: 允许将液体从液体管道转移至气体管道. 仅允许液体单向通过. 通常用于让液体蒸发为气体, 作为空调循环的一部分

desc.en-us:
The Filtration Unit is based on a long-standing ExMin system, itself based on older designs of uncertain provenance. It is available in the Kit (Atmospherics).
The device has nonetheless proven indispensable for Stationeer atmospheric systems, as it can filter two gases simultaneously from a single pipe network using a dual filter array. The unit has an input, and a filter output as well as an unfiltered outlet for any residual gases.
desc.zh-hans:
过滤机基于 ExMin 沿用已久的系统（其设计可追溯至来源不明的更早期方案）, 包含在 (套件)气体设备 套件中.
该设备通过双过滤阵列可从单一管道网络同时过滤两种 气体 , 设有输入口、过滤输出口及残留气体排放口, 现已成为 Stationeer 气体系统不可或缺的组件

desc.en-us: The Fire Extinguisher Storage is a designated shelf specifically designed to hold a fire extinguisher.
desc.zh-hans: 专门用于存放灭火器的指定挂架

desc.en-us: Few objects or ideas are as clearly and transparently named as the Flashing Light, although fans of scrupulous accuracy have been known to refer to it by its full, official title: 'Default Yellow Flashing Light'.
desc.zh-hans: 信号灯的名称直白明了, 尽管严谨派坚持使用其全称「默认黄色闪烁信号灯」

desc.en-us:
The Xigo Koolaid fridge is a self-cooling storage device with 15 slots that preserves food when powered and turned on. While many users have complained about the placement of the power switch, its place in the pantheon of off-world whiteware is unquestioned.

With its own permanent internal atmosphere, the Koolaid fridge slows the decay of food by maintaining an optimal internal temperature. Its power usage varies on the external temperature against which it must balance its internal temperature. As such, it must shed heat to operate, so the Koolaid fridge DOES NOT work in a vacuum.

Also, don't leave the door open, as it will equalize with the current world temperature. And maybe start to beep.

For more information about food preservation, visit the food decay section of the Stationpedia.
desc.zh-hans:
Xigo Koolaid冰箱是拥有15格的自冷存储设备, 通电开启后可保存食物. 尽管用户常抱怨电源开关位置, 但其在外星家电界的地位无可争议.

通过恒定内部大气, 酷乐冰箱维持最佳温度延缓 食物 腐烂. 其功耗随外部温度变化, 需散热运作, 因此无法在真空中工作.

注意: 勿长时间开门, 否则会与外界温度平衡, 并可能触发警报声.

更多食物保存信息请访问站科全书的 食物腐烂 章节

desc.en-us:
Essentially a heavily insulated box that allows users to pipe in any desired atmosphere, the Recurso Minibar fridge was a simple solution to the problem of food decay. It stores a small number of items, at any temperature you can muster.

For more information about food preservation, visit the food decay section of the Stationpedia.
desc.zh-hans:
Recurso 迷你冰箱本质是高度隔热的容器, 可使用管道接入任意设定的大气环境, 为 食物腐烂 问题提供简易解决方案. 它能以任意温度储存少量物品.

更多食物保存信息请访问站科全书的 食物腐烂 章节

desc.en-us:
The Zhurong furnace employs a high-temperature gas mixture of Oxygen and Methane to smelt ingots and a range of alloys as raw materials for fabricators.
A basic gas mixture can be achieved by adding Ice (Oxite) and Ice (Volatiles) in a 1:2 ratio directly to the furnace, but more complex alloys will require careful management of a dedicated gas mixing network. Exact ingredient ratios must be observed. Likewise, smelting ores at insufficient temperatures will produce reagents, which must be recycled.
If liquids are present in the furnace, they will gather there until the furnace is connected to a liquid pipe network.
desc.zh-hans:
祝融熔炉采用 氧气 与 甲烷 混合高温气体, 将 矿石 冶炼为 制造设备 所需的 金属锭 .
基础气体可通过直接添加1:2比例的 氧冰 和 可燃冰 获得, 但复杂合金需精确配比专用混合气体. 温度不足会产生 混合材料 需回收处理. 熔炉内液体积聚时需连接液体管道网络排放

desc.en-us: The Gas Mask Storage is a designated shelf specifically designed to hold a gas mask.
desc.zh-hans: 专门用于存放防毒面罩的指定挂架

desc.en-us: Indispensable for producing precise atmospheric ratios, this gas mixer blends two gases in proportions ranging anywhere from 0-100%.
desc.zh-hans: 气体混合器可精确调配两种气体的混合比例（0-100%范围）, 是制造特定大气配比的关键设备

desc.en-us: Gas sensors are designed to monitor and report basic atmospheric information, including temperature, pressure, and gas ratios. They also make wonderful wedding presents.
desc.zh-hans: 气体传感器用于监测并报告温度、压力及气体比例等基础大气数据——同时也是绝佳的结婚礼物

desc.en-us: When connected to a pipe network, the tank storage unit allows you to refill a Canister, as well as read various atmospheric data from the Gas Canister.
desc.zh-hans: 连接管道网络后, 储气瓶填充器可为 储气瓶 充气, 并通过 气瓶 插槽读取气瓶数据

title.zh-hans: 自泵式气体火箭发动机

desc.en-us: The most reliable of all the rocket engines, the Pumped Gas Engine runs on a 2:1 mix of Methane to Oxygen gas.
desc.zh-hans: 最可靠的火箭发动机类型, 自泵气体发动机以2:1比例的 甲烷 与 氧气 气体混合物作为燃料

desc.en-us: A telescope that can be oriented to observe Celestial Bodies. When within full alignment will show orbital information for that celestial object. Atmospheric conditions may disrupt the ability to observe some objects at some times of day. To collect Horizontal and Vertical values you can use a Rocket Celestial Tracker while it is in orbit, or a Daylight Sensor for primary body data.
desc.zh-hans: 可定向观测天体的地面望远镜. 完全对准时将显示该天体的轨道信息, 大气条件可能导致某些时段无法观测特定天体. 获取水平/垂直定位值可使用轨道中的 火箭天体追踪器 , 或使用 日光传感器 获取主天体数据

desc.en-us: Agrizero's leading hydroponic lighting system, the GrowUp UV light supplements sunshine in low light or sun-distant conditions. The unit adds growability over the space of a grid, so requires proximate placement to work.
desc.zh-hans: Agrizero 领先的水培照明系统, GrowUp紫外线灯可在弱光或远离太阳的环境中补充光照. 该装置在网格空间内提升可种植性, 需近距离放置才能生效

desc.en-us: Use above a Hydroponics Tray or Hydroponics Device to manage the planting and harvest of your crops. It contains a button that will allow you to activate it's modes, or connect it to a logic system to do this for you. The modes indicate current growth status of the plant below. Import is used for planting, and harvested plants are sent to export.
desc.zh-hans: 安装在 水培箱 或 水培箱(数字) 上方管理作物种植/收割. 按钮切换模式或连接逻辑系统, 模式能够显示当前生长状态: 进口槽用于播种, 收割产物输送至出口槽

desc.en-us:
The Recurso OGRE (Orthogonal Ground Rotating Excavator) is a base structure with attached mining vehicle, which will mine a horizontal shaft up to X meters long. When full, the mining vehicle will return to the base to empty itself, before returning to dig. If it encounters empty space, it will also return to base and await instruction. The unit will return if deactivated.

The OGRE can be connected to a chute system, and is controllable by a logic network. Note that the OGRE outputs more ore than a conventional Mining Drill over the same area, due to more efficient processing.

MODES
Idle - 0
Mining - 1
Returning - 2
DepostingOre - 3
Finished - 4
desc.zh-hans:
Recurso OGRE（正交地面旋转挖掘机）是配备采矿车的基础设施, 可挖掘水平巷道最远达X米. 满载后采矿车将返回基地卸货, 随后继续作业. 若遇空腔区域亦会返航待命, 关闭时自动归位.

OGRE可连接滑槽系统并通过逻辑网络控制. 因高效处理工艺, 其 矿石 产量超过同区域 采矿钻机 .

工作模式
待机-0
采矿-1
返程-2
卸矿-3
完成-4

desc.en-us: A go-to tool for all your atmospheric and plumbing needs, the ExMin Atmoprinter will create everything from pipes, pumps and tanks, to vents and filters, ensuring your survival in any environment. Upgrade the Atmoprinter using a Pipe Bender Mod for additional recipes and faster processing speeds.
desc.zh-hans: ExMin Atmoprinter是管道系统全能制造工具, 可制造管道、泵、储罐、通风口及过滤器等设备. 安装 液压弯管机改装件 可解锁更多配方并提升处理速度

desc.en-us:
The Agrizero hydroponics tray is the ideal vessel for growing a range of plantlife. It must be supplied with water using a pipe network, and sufficient light to generate photosynthesis.
It can be automated using the Harvie.
desc.zh-hans: Agrizero 水培箱是培育 植物 的理想设备, 需通过管道网络供水并提供光照进行光合作用, 可使用 农业机械臂 实现自动化管理

desc.en-us:
The Agrizero hydroponics device is the ideal vessel for growing a range of plantlife. It must be supplied with Water using a pipe network, and sufficient light to generate photosynthesis.
It can be automated using the Harvie. Note that unlike the Hydroponics Tray, these cannot be placed consecutively as they are considered devices rather than pure pipes. They do, however, allow data interrogation for logic systems.
desc.zh-hans:
Agrizero 水培装置是种植 植物 的理想容器. 需通过管道网络供应 水 并保证充足光照以进行光合作用.
可使用 农业机械臂 自动化操作. 与 水培箱 不同, 这些装置因归类为设备而非纯管道而无法串行放置, 但支持逻辑系统数据查询

desc.en-us:
The Recurso KoolAuger converts various ices into their respective gases and liquids.
A remarkably smart and compact sublimation-melting unit, it produces gas or liquid depending on the ice being processed. The upper outlet is gas, the lower for liquid, and while you can attach any pipe you like to either outlet, it will only function if the correct network is attached. It will also only pass gas or liquid into a network if it is powered and turned on.
If the KoolAuger is full, it will not accept any further ice until the gas or liquid contents is drained. In this state, it will flash a yellow error state on the activation switch.
desc.zh-hans:
Recurso KoolAuger将各类冰转化为对应 气体 与液体.
智能紧凑的升华-熔化单元根据冰类型产出气体（上出口）或液体（下出口）. 需连接正确管道网络且通电开启方可运作. 若内部已满, 排空前将停止接收原料冰并闪烁黄色警告

desc.en-us: It gets the party started. Especially if that party is an explosive gas mixture.
desc.zh-hans: 引爆派对的最佳选择——尤其当派对主角是易燃易爆气体混合物时

desc.en-us: Klaxons allow you to play over 50 announcements and sounds, depending on your Logic set-up. Set the mode to select the output.
desc.zh-hans: 扬声器可通过 Logic 设置播放50种以上公告和音效, 选择模式以确定输出的内容

title.en-us: Large Direct Heat Exchanger - Gas + Gas
title.zh-hans: 大型间板式换热器(气体+气体)

desc.en-us: Direct Heat Exchangers equalize the temperature of the two input networks.
desc.zh-hans: 直接均衡两个输入管道网络的温度

title.en-us: Large Direct Heat Exchanger - Gas + Liquid
title.zh-hans: 大型间板式换热器(气体+液体)

desc.en-us: Direct Heat Exchangers equalize the temperature of the two input networks.
desc.zh-hans: 直接均衡两个输入管道网络的温度

title.en-us: Large Direct Heat Exchange - Liquid + Liquid
title.zh-hans: 大型间板式换热器(液体+液体)

desc.en-us: Direct Heat Exchangers equalize the temperature of the two input networks.
desc.zh-hans: 直接均衡两个输入管道网络的温度

desc.en-us: Optimized for radiating heat in vacuum and low pressure environments. If pointed at the sun it will heat its contents rapidly via solar heating. The panels can fold away to stop all heat radiation/solar heating and protect them from storms.
desc.zh-hans: 真空低压环境专用散热器, 展开时可通过太阳辐射快速加热内容物. 折叠面板可停止散热/受热并抵御风暴

desc.en-us: 1 x 3 modular door piece for building hangar doors.
desc.zh-hans: 1×3模块化门组件, 用于建造机库门

desc.en-us:
This large communications unit can be used to communicate with nearby trade vessels.

When connected to a Computer (Modern) containing a Communications Motherboard motherboard, a Landingpad Center, and a Vending Machine, this allows Stationeers to contact traders. Adjust its horizontal and vertical attributes either directly or through logic.
desc.zh-hans:
大型通信单元, 可以用来和附近的贸易商船通信.
将其连接到含有 主板(通信) 的 电脑 、 着陆场(中心) 及 智能货柜 后, 可与附近贸易商船通讯. 水平/垂直角度可通过直接操作或逻辑控制调整

desc.en-us:
The atmospherics LArRE can pump gas into and out of its storage canister. When lowered over a Passive Vent, the atmospherics LArRE will connect with it and pump gas into and out of the connected pipe network.

Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.

The base atmospheric logic values point to LArRE's internal gas storage. The Input atmospheric logic values point to the grid that LArRE is in OR the pipe network that LArRE is docked to via a Passive Vent
desc.zh-hans:
气体型LArRE机械臂可泵送气体进出其内部气体存储空间. 当悬停于 被动通风口 上方时, 机械臂将与其连接并对接管道网络进行气体传输.
当机械臂处于主坞站时按下激活按钮, 机械臂将移出主轨道以便其他机械臂通行.
基础气体逻辑值指向LArRE内部存储空间, 输入气体逻辑值指向机械臂所在环境或通过 被动通风口 对接的管道网络

desc.en-us: The bypass dock allows LArRE arms to move off the main rail so that others may pass. Pressing activate on a dock while its arm is at a bypass will cause the arm to move into the bypass' off-rail position.
desc.zh-hans: 旁路驻坞可使LArRE机械臂移出主轨道以便让行其他机械臂. 当机械臂处于旁路坞时激活该坞站, 机械臂将移动至旁路的待机位置并脱离轨道

desc.en-us:
The cargo LArRE can take things out of and put things into slots on devices. The dial on the front panel indicates which slot on the device to interact with. The slot variables of the item in the target slot can be read using the Proxy Slot Index (255)

Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.
desc.zh-hans:
货运型LArRE机械臂可存取设备槽位物品. 前面板拨盘指示交互的目标槽位, 可通过代理槽索引(255)读取目标槽位物品的逻辑参数.
当机械臂处于主坞站时按下激活按钮, 机械臂会移出主轨道以便其他机械臂通行

desc.en-us:
The collector LArRE can suck up nearby loose items when its mode is set to inward and eject stored items when its mode is set to outward. When set to suck up items, the collector LArRE will automatically stop and retract when full.

Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.
desc.zh-hans:
收集型LArRE机械臂在模式设为吸入时可吸取周边散落物品, 设为导出时可释放存储物品. 吸入模式下, 当存储满时将自动停止并缩回.
当机械臂处于主坞站时按下激活按钮, 机械臂会移出主轨道以便其他机械臂通行

desc.en-us:
The hydroponics LArRE can plant and harvest plants as well as place fertiliser into plant trays. It has an additional hopper slot which will feed items into the 'hand' slot when the hand slot is empty. Harvesting a different plant while the hand slot is full will be possible if the hopper slot is empty. In which case the plant in the hand will be moved into the hopper slot and the new plant will be harvested into the hand slot.
The slot variables of a plant in the plant tray below can be read using the Proxy Slot Index (255).
Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.
desc.zh-hans:
农业型LArRE机械臂可进行种植、收割及施肥操作. 配备额外料斗槽, 当手持槽为空时, 料斗槽会自动填充到手持槽内. 若料斗槽为空且手持槽已满, 收割新作物时将会原有手持物品转移至料斗槽.
通过代理槽索引(255)可读取下方种植盘作物的变量参数.
当机械臂处于主坞站时按下激活按钮, 机械臂会移出主轨道以便其他机械臂通行

desc.en-us: When connected to power and activated, it pumps liquid from a liquid network into the world.
desc.zh-hans: 当连接到电源并激活时, 它将液体从液体网络泵入世界

desc.en-us: Adds 1000 joules of heat per tick to the contents of your pipe network. The Pipe Heater will only operate when the pipe pressure is above the armstrong limit (6.3kPa) and the temperature is below 2500 Kelvin.
desc.zh-hans: 每刻将1000焦耳热量添加到管道网络中. 管道加热器只能在高于阿姆斯特朗极限(6.3kPa)的环境中工作, 并且最多加热温度到2500K.

desc.en-us:
A simple heat exchanger, pipe radiators can be placed on pipes to shed or gain heat, depending on the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere. If the atmosphere is hotter, heat will be added to the liquid within the pipe network, and visa versa if colder. In a vacuum, heat will be radiated.
The speed of heat gain or loss will depend on the liquid in question. Adding multiple radiators will speed up heat transfer.
desc.zh-hans:
简单热交换器, 根据环境温度对管道液体进行散热或吸热. 真空环境下辐射散热.
换热速度取决于液体类型, 增加散热器数量可加速热传递

desc.en-us: Regulates the volume ratio of liquid in the output Liquid pipe. This is expressed as percentage where 100 is totally full and 0 is empty.
desc.zh-hans: 调节输出液体管道的容积比率（百分比, 100为全满, 0为空）

desc.en-us: When connected to a liquid pipe network, the tank storage unit allows you to refill a Liquid Canister, as well as read various atmospheric data from the Gas Canister. It will not accept gas canisters.
desc.zh-hans: 连接液体管道网络后, 储液瓶填充器可为 储液瓶 填注液体, 并通过 气瓶 插槽读取数据（不接受储气瓶）

desc.en-us: Shifts 10 times more liquid than a basic Volume Pump, with a mode that can be set to flow in either direction.
desc.zh-hans: 液体传输量为基础 管道容积泵 的10倍, 流动模式可双向切换

desc.en-us: An assignable dial with up to 1000 modes.
desc.zh-hans: 一个可以转动的旋钮, 能够提供最大1000种模式

desc.en-us: A logic device that performs a logical operation on one or more binary inputs that produces a single binary output. An input greater than zero is considered true for operations.
desc.zh-hans: 执行二进制逻辑运算的 逻辑 设备, 输入大于零视为真值

desc.en-us: A PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) controller that provides a closed-loop feedback mechanism that can be used to automatically regulate a process variable (like temperature, speed, position, and similar) so that it tracks a desired setpoint. It does this by continually computing an error signal e(t) = setpoint – measurement, then applying three corrective actions as the Proportional, Integral, and Derivative.
desc.zh-hans: 提供闭环反馈机制的PID（比例积分微分）控制器, 可自动调节过程变量(如温度, 速度, 位置等)使其追踪目标设定值. 通过持续计算误差信号e(t)=设定值-测量值, 并施加比例, 积分和微分三重校正作用实现精确自动控制.

desc.en-us: Contains an Internal Memory which is assessed to check whether something should be sorted. When an item is in the Import Slot, the stack is checked and if result is true the thing is moved to the Export 2 slot, otherwise it is moved to the Export slot. The Mode is used in how the stack is assessed, by default the mode is ALL, so every instruction in the stack would need to return true.
desc.zh-hans: 内置存储器用于物品分拣判定. 当物品进入 输入 槽时, 系统将检测堆栈数据指令: 若结果为真则转移至 输出2 槽, 否则转移至 输出 槽. 默认检测模式为ALL（全匹配）, 即堆栈内所有数据指令均需返回真值

desc.en-us: Connects to Logic Transmitter
Can be welded using a Welding Torch or Arc Welder to lock it in the current state. Use the welder again to unlock.
desc.zh-hans: 可用 气焊枪 或 电焊枪 焊接锁定当前状态, 再次焊接解除

desc.en-us: A stand-alone radiator unit optimized for exchanging heat with its surrounding atmosphere.
desc.zh-hans: 独立散热单元, 优化大气环境热交换

title.zh-hans: 中型对流式液体散热器

desc.en-us: A stand-alone liquid radiator unit optimized for exchanging heat with its surrounding atmosphere.
desc.zh-hans: 独立液体散热单元, 优化大气环境热交换

desc.en-us: 1 x 2 modular door piece for building hangar doors.
desc.zh-hans: 1×2模块化门组件, 用于建造机库门

desc.en-us: A stand-alone radiator unit optimized for radiating heat in vacuums.
desc.zh-hans: 独立真空辐射散热单元, 可将热量辐射到真空中

desc.en-us: A stand-alone liquid radiator unit optimized for radiating heat in vacuums.
desc.zh-hans: 独立液体真空辐射散热单元, 可将热量辐射到真空中

desc.en-us:
Originally developed to monitor dance marathons, the motion sensor can also be connected to Logic systems for security purposes, automatic lighting, doors and various other applications.
The sensor activates whenever a player enters the grid it is placed on.
desc.zh-hans: 最初为舞蹈马拉松监测设计的运动传感器, 可连接 逻辑系统 实现安防警报、自动照明、门禁等功能. 当玩家进入传感器所在网格时触发

desc.en-us: This device is used to create Nitrous Oxide from Oxygen, Nitrogen, and a large amount of energy. The process does not completely transform all the available gas at once, so the output is a mix of all three gasses, which may need further processing.  More NOS will be created, if the gas inside the machine is close to a 1/1 ratio of Oxygen to Nitrogen.  The second gas input line in optional, and not required if the gas is pre mixed.
desc.zh-hans: 利用 氧气 、 氮气 与大量能量合成 一氧化二氮 . 氧气氮气1:1比例时效率最高, 输出为混合气体需二次处理. 第二进气口可以选择性连接, 已预先按比例混合气体无需连接

desc.en-us: Will be triggered if there is a player in the same room as the sensor. The quantity variable will show the number of players. You can use configure it to only detect players who hold the correct Access Card using a Cartridge (Access Controller) in a Handheld Tablet. This sensor only works when placed in a room.
desc.zh-hans: 检测同房间玩家（用逻辑属性quantity表示）. 需放置于室内, 配合 平板电脑 插入 功能卡(门禁) 可限定识别持有对应门禁卡的玩家

desc.en-us: The Loader will take objects from its left slot and put them in the available slots of the object inserted in the right slot. The slots will be filled in order from first to last. If no available slot is found, the left slot object will be ejected. The right slot object will auto eject once full or if the level is pulled.
desc.zh-hans: 装载机会从其左侧插槽中取出物品, 并将其放入右侧插槽物品的可用插槽中. 插槽将按从第一个到最后一个的顺序填充. 如果找不到可用插槽, 则左侧插槽中的物品将被弹出. 右侧插槽中的物品一旦装满或是拉下拉杆, 将会自动弹出。

desc.en-us: Has been replaced by Medium Convection Radiator.
desc.zh-hans: 已被 中型对流式散热器 替代

title.zh-hans: 中型对流式液体散热器

desc.en-us: Has been replaced by Medium Convection Radiator Liquid.
desc.zh-hans: 已被 中型对流式液体散热器 替代

desc.en-us: Moves liquids from a pipe network to the world atmosphere.
desc.zh-hans: 将液体从管道网络排放至外界大气环境

title.zh-hans: 逆流式换热器(气体+气体)

desc.en-us:
Exchange heat from one pipe network to another. By drawing down the pressure of the outputs with a pump or regulator and regulating input pressures, the temperatures of two counterflowing networks can be effectively exchanged.
Balancing the throughput of both inputs is key to creating a good exhange of temperatures.
desc.zh-hans:
通过调节输出端泵或调节器的压力降并控制输入压力, 实现两个逆向流动的管道网络之间的有效热交换.
平衡两个输入端的流量是获得良好热交换效果的关键

title.zh-hans: 逆流式换热器(气体+液体)

Exchange heat from one pipe network to another. By drawing down the pressure of the outputs with a pump or regulator and regulating input pressures, the temperatures of two counterflowing networks can be effectively exchanged.
Balancing the throughput of both inputs is key to creating a good exhange of temperatures.

通过调节输出端泵或调节器的压力降并控制输入压力, 实现两个逆向流动的管道网络之间的有效热交换.
平衡两个输入端的流量是获得良好热交换效果的关键

Exchange heat from one pipe network to another. By drawing down the pressure of the outputs with a pump or regulator and regulating input pressures, the temperatures of two counterflowing networks can be effectively exchanged.

desc.en-us:
Allegedly the outcome of a weekend father-daughter electronics project by an overzealous {ExMin engineer, the pipe analyzer is essentially a more advanced version of the Pipe Meter.
Displaying the internal pressure of pipe networks, it  also reads out temperature and gas contents, and can be connected to a Console or Computer (Modern) via a {Logic system.
desc.zh-hans:
据称是某位 ExMin 工程师与女儿周末电子项目的成果, 管道分析仪本质上是 管道仪表 的升级版.
可显示管道网络内部压力、温度及气体成分, 并能通过 逻辑系统 连接至 控制台 或 电脑

desc.en-us: Adds 1000 joules of heat per tick to the contents of your pipe network. The Pipe Heater will only operate when the pipe pressure is above the armstrong limit (6.3kPa) and the temperature is below 2500 Kelvin.
desc.zh-hans: 每刻将1000焦耳热量添加到管道网络中. 管道加热器只能在高于阿姆斯特朗极限(6.3kPa)的环境中工作, 并且最多加热温度到2500K.

desc.en-us: Ignites the atmosphere inside the attached pipe network.
desc.zh-hans: 能够点燃所连接管道网络内的气体环境

desc.en-us: As its perspicacious name suggests, the pipe label is designed to be attached to a straight stretch of pipe. Users can then label the label with the Labeller.
desc.zh-hans: 顾名思义, 管道标签用于标记直管段. 用户可用 贴标机 在标签上添加注释

desc.en-us:
While the Stationeers program has, thus far, inspired little in the way of classical poetry, the following haiku was found etched, ironically, on a piece of pipe wreckage found on Vulcan:
"Humble pipe meter
speaks the truth, transmits pressure
within any pipe"
desc.zh-hans:
尽管Stationeer计划至今鲜少激发古典诗词创作, 但火神星上的某块管道残骸上刻着这首讽刺俳句:
「谦卑管道表
诉说真实传压力
无问管道形」

desc.en-us: The pipe organ can be attached to one end of a Kit (Pipe Valve). The length of the pipe after the pipe organ changes the pitch of the note it will play when the valve is opened. Use Logic to open and close the valves to create some custom tunes for your base or an audible warning.
desc.zh-hans: 管风琴可安装在 (套件)管道阀 末端, 后方管道长度决定阀门开启时的音高. 通过 逻辑信号 控制阀门开关, 可创作基地背景音乐或警报音效

desc.en-us:
A simple heat exchanger, pipe radiators can be placed on pipes to shed or gain heat, depending on the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere. If the atmosphere is hotter, heat will be added the gas within the pipe network, and visa versa if colder. In a vacuum, heat will be radiated.
The speed of heat gain or loss will depend on the gas in question. Adding multiple radiators will speed up heat transfer.
desc.zh-hans:
简易热交换装置, 管道散热器可置于管道上散热或吸热（取决于环境大气温度）. 若环境温度更高, 热量会导入管网气体；反之则导出. 真空中将辐射散热.
热交换速度取决于气体种类, 增加散热器数量可提升效率

desc.en-us: A pipe mounted radiator optimized for radiating heat in vacuums.
desc.zh-hans: 管道附加式真空散热器

desc.en-us: A liquid pipe mounted radiator optimized for radiating heat in vacuums.
desc.zh-hans: 液体管道附加式真空散热器

desc.en-us: A small planter for decorative or hydroponic purposes. Can be connected to Water, or watered manually using a Water Bottle or Liquid Canister (Water).
desc.zh-hans: 用于装饰或水培的小型种植盆. 可连接 水 系统, 或使用 水瓶 、 储液瓶(水) 手动浇水

desc.en-us: Attaches a Kit (Portable Generator) to a power network.
desc.zh-hans: 能够将 (套件)便携式发电机 接入电网的连接装置

desc.en-us:
The Norsec Wireless Power Transmitter is an uni-directional, A-to-B, far field microwave electrical transmission system.The rotatable base transmitter delivers a narrow, non-lethal microwave beam to a dedicated base receiver.
The transmitter must be aligned to the base station in order to transmit any power. The brightness of the transmitter's collimator arc provides an indication of transmission intensity. Note that there is an attrition over longer ranges, so the unit requires more power over greater distances to deliver the same output.
desc.zh-hans:
Norsec 无线输电系统采用单向远场微波传输技术, 可旋转基座发射器向专用接收器定向发射无害微波束.

需精确对准基站才能传输电力, 准直器弧光亮度指示传输强度. 注意远距离传输存在衰减, 需更高输入功率维持输出

desc.en-us:
The Norsec Wireless Power Transmitter is an uni-directional, A-to-B, far field microwave electrical transmission system.The rotatable base transmitter delivers a narrow, non-lethal microwave beam to a dedicated base receiver.
The transmitter must be aligned to the base station in order to transmit any power. The brightness of the transmitter's collimator arc provides an indication of transmission intensity. Note that there is an attrition over longer ranges, so the unit requires more power over greater distances to deliver the same output.
desc.zh-hans:
