需精确对准基站才能传输电力, 准直器弧光亮度指示传输强度. 注意远距离传输存在衰减, 需更高输入功率维持输出

desc.en-us: Great for moving large quantities of air into a pipe network. Its primary purpose is for the creation of multi-grid airlocks. It can effeciently pull a vacuum on a small to medium sized room.
desc.zh-hans: 专为将大量气体输送至管道网络设计, 主要应用于多舱室气闸系统建造. 能高效完成中小型舱室的真空抽取作业

desc.en-us: For building large scale airlock systems and pressurised hangers, a bigger and bolder version of the Powered Vent that can effeciently pull a vacuum in large room.
desc.zh-hans: 专为建造大型气闸系统和加压机库设计, 是 动力通风扇(中型) 的强化版本, 可高效完成大型舱室的真空抽取作业

desc.en-us: Pumps gas into a liquid pipe in order to raise the pressure
desc.zh-hans: 向液体管道泵入气体以提高压力

title.zh-hans: 供压式气体火箭发动机

desc.en-us: Inefficient but very powerful, the Pressure Fed Gas Engine moves gas from each of its two inputs based on the pressure of the input pipes. Control the mixing ratio of fuels by tweaking the input pressures to target a 2:1 mix of Methane to Oxygen gas. Chilling propellant gasses or using Nitrous Oxide as an oxydizer will result in even higher thrust outputs.
desc.zh-hans: 虽效率较低但推力强劲, 供压式气体发动机根据输入管道压力自动调节双燃料输入量. 通过调整输入压力控制燃料混合比例, 建议维持 甲烷 与 氧气 气体2:1的混合比. 冷却推进剂气体或使用 一氧化二氮 作为氧化剂可进一步提升推力输出

title.zh-hans: 重型供压式气体火箭发动机

desc.en-us: A larger more powerful variant of the Pressure Fed Gas Engine. It sacrifices a small amount of efficiency for greatly increased thrust. Pressure Fed Gas Engines move gas from each of their inputs based on the pressure of the input pipes. Control the mixing ratio of fuels by tweaking the input pressures to target a 2:1 mix of Methane to Oxygen gas. Chilling propellant gasses or using Nitrous Oxide as an oxydizer will result in even higher thrust outputs.
desc.zh-hans: 供压式气体火箭发动机的增强型变体. 它通过牺牲少量效率换取推力的大幅提升. 供压式发动机根据输入管道的压力从各个输入端输送气体. 可以通过调整输入压力来控制燃料混合比例, 以达成 甲烷 与 氧气 混合比2:1的目标. 使用冷却燃料气体或使用 一氧化二氮 作为氧化剂会输出更高的推力

title.zh-hans: 供压式液体火箭发动机

desc.en-us: Highly efficient and powerful, the Pressure Fed Liquid Engine is a challenging engine to run in a stable configuration. Liquid is pulled from the input into the engine based on the input gas pressure. Some gas is also moved in this process so Stationeers will need to devise a system to maintain a high gas pressure in the liquid input pipe. The second liquid pipe connection is an optional heat-exchanger connection which exchanges heat between the pipes contents and the engine bell, the Setting variable drives the effectiveness of the heat-exchanger.
desc.zh-hans: 高效强力, 但运行稳定性要求较高的供压式液体发动机. 燃料输入量由输入管道的气压决定, 在此过程中会伴随少量气体输入, 需设计系统维持液体输入管道的高气压环境. 发动机第二液体管口为可选热交换接口, 用于管道内容物与发动机喷管之间的热交换, 逻辑变量设置可调节热交换效率

title.zh-hans: 重型供压式液体火箭发动机

desc.en-us: A larger more powerful variant of the Pressure Fed Liquid Engine. It sacrifices a small amount of efficiency for greatly increased thrust. Warning, Pressure Fed Liquid Engines are challenging engine to run in a stable configuration. Liquid is pulled from the input into the engine based on the input gas pressure. Some gas is also moved in this process so Stationeers will need to devise a system to maintain a high gas pressure in the liquid input pipe. The second liquid pipe connection is an optional heat-exchanger connection which exchanges heat between the pipes contents and the engine bell, the Setting variable drives the effectiveness of the heat-exchanger.
desc.zh-hans: 供压式液体火箭发动机的增强型变体. 它通过牺牲少量效率换取推力的大幅提升. 警告: 供压式发动机需要精密调控才能稳定运行. 液体燃料基于输入气体压力从输入端被吸入发动机, 此过程会同时带入部分气体, Stationeers需要设计一套系统来维持液体输入管道的气压. 第二个液体管道连接口是可选的热交换器接口, 用于在管道内容物与发动机喷管间进行热交换, 发动机的Setting变量可调节该换热器的效果

desc.en-us: Controlling the flow of gas between two pipe networks, pressure regulators shift gas until a set pressure on the outlet side is achieved, or the gas supply is exhausted. The back pressure regulator, by contrast, will only operate when pressure on the intake side exceeds the set value. With a max pressure of over 20,000kPa, it requires power to operate.
desc.zh-hans: 压力调节器通过转移气体控制两管网间流量, 直至出口侧达设定压力或气源耗尽. 对比之下, 背压调节器仅在入口压力超设定值时工作. 最大承压超20000kPa, 需供电运行

desc.en-us: Will be triggered if there is a player in the range of the sensor (as defined by the setting dial). The quantity variable will show the number of players. You can configure the sensor to only detect players who hold the correct Access Card using a Cartridge (Access Controller) in a Handheld Tablet.
desc.zh-hans: 检测设定范围内玩家数量(用逻辑属性quantity表示). 配合 平板电脑 插入 功能卡(门禁) 可限定识别持有对应门禁卡的玩家

title.zh-hans: 自泵式液体火箭发动机

desc.en-us: Liquid propellants bring greater efficiencies with Pumped Liquid Engine. Two inputs are provided so Stationeers can seperate their fuels, the Setting variable controls the mixing ratio of the inputs. The engine is designed to run on Liquid Methane and Liquid Oxygen, some Stationeers have reported excessive thrust values by switching to Liquid Nitrous Oxide
desc.zh-hans: 采用液体推进剂的自泵式发动机, 效能更高. 配备双输入口供Stationeer分别供应燃料和氧化剂, 通过设置变量控制输入燃料的混合比例. 该发动机设计使用 液态甲烷 和 液氧 作为燃料, 部分Stationeer报告改用 液态一氧化二氮 后推力显著提升

desc.en-us: Allows for removal of pressurant gas and evaporated liquids from a liquid pipe. Similar in function to a Back Pressure Regulator the Purge Valve moves gas from the input liquid pipe to the output gas pipe aiming to keep the pressure of the input at the target setting.
desc.zh-hans: 允许从液体管道中移除气体和液体蒸气. 功能类似 背压调节器 ,  排气阀 将气体从输入液体管转移至输出气体管, 旨在维持输入压力在目标设定值

desc.en-us:
The CryoSurge Radio Storage offers a place to safely hold your Hand-Held Radio in place.
The Radio will still function as a receiver while its in the radio slot but has to be taken out to transmit, we recommend the radio be equipped with a wireless battery.

The CryoSurge Radio Tower offers a solution to the problem of even longer distance communications.
Any radio's in the signal range of a Tower will be boosted & will be able to transmit & receive on the same channel even if they're on a different world, universe or galaxy.

Tower passive power usage: 200W
Tower active power usage : Effected by signal (Setting). 1 Setting = 15W.

A device for collecting the raw resources while destroying an item. Produces Reagent Mix containing packages of reagents. Pass these through the Centrifuge to gain back the source ores. Plants and organic matter passed through will create Biomass, which when passed through the Centrifuge will produce Biomass.
desc.zh-hans: 回收站通过销毁物品回收原料, 产出含原料的 混合原料 （经 离心机 处理可还原原始矿石）. 当用于处理植物时能够生成生物质, 离心后获得 生物质

desc.en-us:
The refrigerated OmniKool vending machine is an advanced version of the standard Vending Machine, which maintains an optimum pressure and constant temperature of -130 degrees C, to prevent food spoilage. It can hold up to 100 stacks.
The OmniKool also has an in-built Stacker, allowing players to set the stack sizes of any items ADDED to the device. The unit's default stack size is 50.
NOTE: altering stack sizes DOES NOT update existing stacks within the machine, only those subsequently added.
desc.zh-hans:
冷藏OmniKool自动售货机是标准 智能货柜 的升级版, 可维持-130°C恒温及最佳气压防止食物腐败, 最多容纳100组物品.

该设备内置 堆垛机 , 允许玩家设定放入物品的堆叠数量, 默认堆叠量为50.
注意: 调整堆叠量仅对后续放入的物品生效, 已有的堆叠不会更新

desc.en-us: The linear rail door allows LArRE arms to pass through while travelling along a rail network.
desc.zh-hans: 允许LArRE机械臂在轨道网络中穿行的可开启式轨道门

desc.en-us: The Linear Articulated Rail Entity or LArRE can be used to plant, harvest and fertilize plants in plant trays. It can also grab items from a Chute Export Bin and drop them in a Chute Import Bin. LArRE can interact with plant trays or chute bins built under a linear rail station or built under its dock.
desc.zh-hans: 线性铰接轨道实体(LArRE)可为水培箱作物种植、收割和施肥, 也可以从 电动滑槽(出口) 抓取物品并投放至 滑槽(回收) . LArRE可与线性轨道站下方或其坞站下方的水培箱/滑槽进行交互

desc.en-us: The Celestial Tracker can be placed in Rockets and when turned on will provide data that can be used to orientate devices such as the Telescope. The Horizontal and Vertical output is localized to the orientation of the tracker. You can calibrate your alignment by comparing the result for the primary body with the output from the Daylight Sensor. Full functionality will only be available in orbit, but you can configure using the primary body. For aligning with the telescope, have the face plate facing up and the cables facing in the same direction as for the telescope and the output values will be aligned.
desc.zh-hans: 可安装在火箭上的天体追踪装置, 启动后提供用于定向设备（如 天文望远镜 ）的定位数据. 水平/垂直输出值基于追踪器自身方位, 可通过对比主天体数据与 日光传感器 输出值进行校准. 完整功能需在轨道运行状态下启用, 但可配置主天体参数进行基础使用. 与望远镜校准时需确保装置面板朝上且线缆方向与望远镜一致, 输出值将自动对齐

desc.en-us: Allows for basic gas filtration onboard a Rocket.
desc.zh-hans: 为火箭提供基础气体过滤功能

desc.en-us: When fitted on a Rocket, this device will allow the collection of gaseous atmospheres from various planetoids.
desc.zh-hans: 安装于火箭时, 可从各类星体环境中采集气态大气

desc.en-us: The Payload Bay Large functions as an attachment point for the Payload Delivery Container. Set the deploy location by setting the PositionX and PositionZ logic variables on the device. Use the deploy action on the rocket location panel to deploy an attached payload. The Open logic variable must be set to 1 to commence payload deploy.
desc.zh-hans: 大型载荷舱 可以挂载 载荷投送容器舱 . 通过设置设备上的 PositionX 和 PositionZ 逻辑变量来设置目标位置. 使用火箭位置面板上的部署动作来投送装载的载荷. 必须先将Open逻辑变量设置为1才能进行投送.

desc.en-us: Gathers available resources at the rocket's current space location. Mining also generates a small trickle of survey points at the location.
desc.zh-hans: 在火箭当前所处太空地点采集可用资源. 采矿作业还会在该位置生成少量勘探点数

desc.en-us: The majestic silo holds large quantities of almost anything. While it is doing that, it cannot be deconstructed. Note also, that any food you put into a silo is likely to decay extremely rapidly. The silo can hold up to 600 stacks.
desc.zh-hans: 巨型仓储装置, 可容纳大量物资（内部有物资时不可拆除）. 注意存入食物会导致其 急速腐烂 , 最大容量600组

desc.en-us:
This medium communications unit can be used to communicate with nearby trade vessels.

When connected to a Computer (Modern) containing a Communications Motherboard motherboard, a Landingpad Center, and a Vending Machine, this allows Stationeers to contact traders. Adjust its horizontal and vertical attributes either directly or through logic.
desc.zh-hans: 中型通信装置, 可用于与附近的贸易飞船通信. 当连接到 着陆场(中心) 和 智能货柜 以及包含 主板(通信) 的 电脑 时, 允许太空工程师联系贸易商人. 可通过直接操作或逻辑电路调整其水平和垂直属性

desc.en-us: Nothing says 'I care' like a CCTV camera that's been linked a Motion Sensor and a Console fitted with a Circuitboard (CCTV/LD),Circuitboard (CCTV/SD),Circuitboard (CCTV/HD) or a Circuitboard (CCTV/SCAN). Be there, even when you're not.Connects to Logic Transmitter

Nothing says 'I care' like a CCTV camera that's been linked a Motion Sensor and a Console fitted with a Circuitboard (CCTV/LD),Circuitboard (CCTV/SD),Circuitboard (CCTV/HD) or a Circuitboard (CCTV/SCAN). Be there, even when you're not.Connects to Logic Transmitter

Nothing says 'I care' like a CCTV camera that's been linked a Motion Sensor and a Console fitted with a Circuitboard (CCTV/LD),Circuitboard (CCTV/SD),Circuitboard (CCTV/HD) or a Circuitboard (CCTV/SCAN). Be there, even when you're not.Connects to Logic Transmitter

Nothing says 'I care' like a CCTV camera that's been linked a Motion Sensor and a Console fitted with a Circuitboard (CCTV/LD),Circuitboard (CCTV/SD),Circuitboard (CCTV/HD) or a Circuitboard (CCTV/SCAN). Be there, even when you're not.Connects to Logic Transmitter

Nothing says 'I care' like a CCTV camera that's been linked a Motion Sensor and a Console fitted with a Circuitboard (CCTV/LD),Circuitboard (CCTV/SD),Circuitboard (CCTV/HD) or a Circuitboard (CCTV/SCAN). Be there, even when you're not.Connects to Logic Transmitter

Any Stationeer concerned about security needs the Harkwell-designed Vigilant-E security printer. Use the Vigilant-E to create a Cartridge (Access Controller), in order to restrict access to different parts of your base via keycards like the Access Card (Blue). The printer also makes a variety of weapons and ammunitions to defend your base against any hostile, aggressive or just slightly rude entites you encounter as you explore the Solar System.
desc.zh-hans: Harkwell 设计的Vigilant-E安全打印机可制造 功能卡(门禁) 门禁芯片, 配合 通行卡(蓝) 等钥匙卡限制基地区域访问, 同时支持生产武器弹药抵御抵御在探索太阳系过程中遇到的任何敌意、侵略或粗鲁的敌人

desc.en-us: A shelf for putting things on, so you can see them.
desc.zh-hans: 一个用于放置物品的架子, 方便查看

desc.en-us: The fastest way to remove low hygiene. You must remove your Jump Suit (Orange) and Eva Suit when using the Shower. It outputs Polluted Water when in use. Polluted Water will interfere with many other Water systems so make sure to collect and treat it using a Water Purifier or dump it.
desc.zh-hans: 快速消除低卫生值状态的设备. 使用 淋浴器 时必须脱下 连体衣(橙色) 和 太空服 . 使用时会排放 污水 , 该物质如果混用会干扰其他 水 系统, 需通过 净水器 净化处理或直接排放

desc.en-us: The fastest way to remove low hygiene. You must remove your Jump Suit (Orange) and Eva Suit when using the Shower (Powered). It outputs Polluted Water when in use. Polluted Water will interfere with many other Water systems so make sure to collect and treat it using a Water Purifier or dump it.
desc.zh-hans: 快速消除卫生值状态的电动设备. 使用 电动淋浴器 时必须脱下 连体衣(橙色) 和 太空服 . 使用时会排放 污水 , 该物质会干扰其他 水 系统, 需通过 净水器 净化处理或直接排放

desc.en-us: A horizontal variant of the sleeper. Will keep players hydrated and fed while they are logged out - as long as a breathable atmosphere is provided.
desc.zh-hans: 左侧水平睡眠舱, 维持呼吸环境可为离线玩家提供水分以及食物补给

desc.en-us: A horizontal variant of the sleeper. Will keep players hydrated and fed while they are logged out - as long as a breathable atmosphere is provided.
desc.zh-hans: 右侧水平睡眠舱, 维持呼吸环境可为离线玩家提供水分以及食物补给

desc.en-us: The vertical variant of the sleeper. Will keep players hydrated and fed while they are logged out - as long as a breathable atmosphere is provided.
desc.zh-hans: 立式睡眠舱, 维持呼吸环境可为离线玩家提供水分以及食物补给

desc.en-us: The Droid Sleeper will recharge robot batteries and equiped suit batteries if present. This sleeper variant is only safe for robots. Entering as a non robot character will cause you to take damage.
desc.zh-hans: 机器人睡眠舱能够为机器人自身的电池及太空服电池充电. 但仅限机器人角色使用, 非机器人角色进入将受到伤害

title.en-us: Small Direct Heat Exchanger - Gas + Gas
title.zh-hans: 小型间板式换热器(气体+气体)

desc.en-us: Direct Heat Exchangers equalize the temperature of the two input networks.
desc.zh-hans: 直接均衡两个输入管道网络的温度

title.en-us: Small Direct Heat Exchanger - Liquid + Gas
title.zh-hans: 小型间板式换热器(气体+液体)

desc.en-us: Direct Heat Exchangers equalize the temperature of the two input networks.
desc.zh-hans: 直接均衡两个输入管道网络的温度

title.en-us: Small Direct Heat Exchanger - Liquid + Liquid
title.zh-hans: 小型间板式换热器(液体+液体)

desc.en-us: Direct Heat Exchangers equalize the temperature of the two input networks.
desc.zh-hans: 直接均衡两个输入管道网络的温度

desc.en-us:
This small communications unit can be used to communicate with nearby trade vessels.

When connected to a Computer (Modern) containing a Communications Motherboard motherboard, a Landingpad Center, and a Vending Machine, this allows Stationeers to contact traders. Adjust its horizontal and vertical attributes either directly or through logic.
desc.zh-hans:
小型通信单元, 可以用来和附近的贸易商船通信.
将其连接到含有 主板(通信) 的 电脑 、 着陆场(中心) 及 智能货柜 后, 可与附近贸易商船通讯. 水平/垂直角度可通过直接操作或逻辑控制调整

desc.en-us: Sinotai's standard solar panels are used for generating power from sunlight. They can be connected to Logic systems, in order to track sunlight, but their reduced during storms and when damaged. You can repair these using some trusty Duct Tape.
desc.zh-hans: Sinotai 标准太阳能板通过光照发电, 可连接 逻辑系统 实现日光追踪功能. 风暴期间或受损时效率下降, 可使用 胶带 进行维修

desc.en-us: Sinotai basic solar panels generate power from sunlight, sitting at 45 degrees to the ground. Their efficiency is reduced during storms and when damaged. You can repair these using some trusty Duct Tape.
desc.zh-hans: Sinotai 基础太阳能板以45度角安装发电, 风暴或受损会导致发电效率降低, 可用 胶带 进行维修

title.zh-hans: 重型固定式太阳能板(斜置)

desc.en-us: This solar panel is resistant to storm damage.
desc.zh-hans: 该太阳能板可抵御风暴伤害

desc.en-us: Sinotai dual solar panels are used for generating power from sunlight, with dedicated data and power ports. They can be connected to {Logic systems, in order to track sunlight, but their efficiency is reduced during storms and when damaged. You can repair these using some trusty Duct Tape.
desc.zh-hans: Sinotai 双口太阳能板配备独立数据/电源接口, 可以连接到 { Logic 系统, 并通过日光追踪逻辑提升发电效率（风暴或受损时效率下降）, 可使用 胶带 进行维修

title.zh-hans: 重型可动式太阳能板(双口)

desc.en-us: This solar panel is resistant to storm damage.
desc.zh-hans: 该太阳能板可抵御风暴伤害

desc.en-us: Sinotai basic solar panels generate power from sunlight. They lie flat to the ground, and their efficiency is reduced during storms and when damaged. You can repair these using some trusty Duct Tape.
desc.zh-hans: Sinotai 基础太阳能板平铺地面发电, 风暴或受损会导致发电效率降低, 可用 胶带 进行维修

title.zh-hans: 重型固定式太阳能板(平置)

desc.en-us: This solar panel is resistant to storm damage.
desc.zh-hans: 该太阳能板可抵御风暴伤害

title.zh-hans: 重型可动式太阳能板(单口)

desc.en-us: This solar panel is resistant to storm damage.
desc.zh-hans: 该太阳能板可抵御风暴伤害

desc.en-us: The mainstay of power generation for Stationeers, this device provides 20kW of power. Multiple solid resources can be loaded. While operating, the device will output its maximum power regardless of whether you have captured it or not. Watch for blown wires! It will output much more power than your regular Cable Coil can handle.
desc.zh-hans: 作为Stationeer的主力发电设备, 该装置提供20kW电力, 可装载多种固体燃料. 运行时将持续输出最大功率（无论是否接入电网）, 注意电线过载!其输出远超普通 电缆 的承载能力

desc.en-us: No amount of automation is complete without some way of moving different items to different parts of a system. The Xigo A2B sorter can be programmed via a computer with a Sorter Motherboard to direct various items into different chute networks. Filtered items are always passed out the righthand side of the sorter, while non filtered items continue straight through.
desc.zh-hans: 自动化系统需分拣物品至不同路径.  Xigo A2B分拣机可通过装有 主板(分拣) 的计算机进行编程, 将指定物品导向右侧滑槽网络, 未过滤物品则直行通过

desc.en-us: It’s a spotlight... bright, focused, and it cuts through the dark. Connect it to logic, and it becomes a searchlight, sweeping across your perimeter. Adjustable speed - set Mode from 0-10.

A stacker is an important part of any automated chute network. The Xigo ProKompile can be set manually or via logic, to make sure items passing through the stacker are maximized for your storage needs.
The ProKompile can stack a wide variety of things such as ingots, as well as splitting stacks into appropriate sizes as needed.
desc.zh-hans: 堆垛机是自动化滑槽网络的核心组件.  Xigo ProKompile可手动或通过逻辑设置, 优化物品堆叠以适应存储需求, 支持 金属锭 等材料的堆叠与拆分

desc.en-us:
A stacker is an important part of any automated chute network. The Xigo ProKompile can be set manually or via logic, to make sure items passing through the stacker are maximized for your storage needs. The reversed stacker has power and data on the opposite side.
The ProKompile can stack a wide variety of things such as ingots, as well as splitting stacks into appropriate sizes as needed.

desc.en-us:
Harnessing an ancient thermal exploit, the Recurso 'Libra' Stirling Engine generates power via the expansion and contraction of a working gas to drive pistons operating an electrical generator.

When high pressure hot gas is supplied into the input pipe, this gas will heat the hot side of the unit, then pass into the output pipe. The cooler side uses the room's ambient atmosphere, which must be kept at a lower temperature and pressure in order to create a differential. Add a working gas by inserting a Gas Canister. The unit must be deactivated when adding or removing canisters, or the working gas may leak into the surrounding atmosphere.

Gases with a low molecular mass make the most efficient working gases. Increasing the moles of working gas can result in a greater potential power output. However, overpressuring the unit may have... sub-optimal results.
desc.zh-hans:
Recurso 'Libra'斯特林发电机利用古老热力学原理, 通过工作气体膨胀收缩驱动活塞发电.

输入高压热气加热装置热端后排出, 冷端依赖环境低温低压形成温差. 需通过 气瓶 注入工作气体, 操作时必须关闭设备以防气体泄漏.

低分子量气体效率最佳. 增加气体摩尔数可提升潜在功率, 但过压将导致不良后果

desc.en-us:
The Xigo Freezy Boi wall cooler complements the wall heater, which can only raise the temperature. The wall cooler functions by drawing heat from the surrounding atmosphere and adding that heat into its pipe network.
In order to run the wall cooler properly, you will need to connect pipes to the wall cooler and fill the connected pipe network with any type of gas. The gas's heat capacity and volume will determine how fast it reacts to temperature changes.

EFFICIENCY
The higher the difference in temperature between the gas stored in the pipes and the room, the less efficient the wall cooler will be. So to keep the wall cooler running at an acceptable efficiency you will need to get rid of the heat that accumulates in the pipes connected to it. A common practice would be to run the pipes to the outside and use radiators on the outside section of the pipes to get rid of the heat.
The less efficient the wall cooler, the less power it consumes. It will consume 1010W at max efficiency. The wall cooler can be controlled by logic chips to run when the temperature hits a certain degree.
ERRORS
If the wall cooler is flashing an error then it is missing one of the following:

- Pipe connection to the wall cooler.
- Gas in the connected pipes, or pressure is too low.
- Atmosphere in the surrounding environment or pressure is too low.

For more information about how to control temperatures, consult the temperature control Guides page.

环境缺少空气或压力过低
